semiconductor_relevance: High — Micson Automation specializes in the design and manufacturing of semiconductor equipment, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Micson Automation (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. focuses on the R&D, design, and manufacturing of semiconductor and PCB-related equipment. With a diverse product line that includes wafer-level and board-level packaging machines, the company serves over 130 clients globally, providing essential tools for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
